ValidationRule.description: Prevents System Administrators from editing records when the Status is currently 'In-Progress' Acknowledged, Completed, Withdrawn.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Acknowledged"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "In-Progress"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Withdrawn") ), ($Profile.Name = "System Administrator") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to edit this record.
